replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves finding the directions of maximum variance in data. Step one: Center the data. Step two: Compute the covariance matrix. Step three: Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix. Step four: Sort the eigenvalues in descending order. Step five: Select the top k eigenvectors to form a new coordinate system. Step six: Project the data onto these k new axes. The mathematics is abstract, but the goal is to simplify data while retaining most variation.
